mapper.insert: insert into SF01 (seq, title, text, userid, regdate, filename, ftpfilename) values (SEQ_SF01.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{text}, #{userid}, #{regdate}, #{filename}, #{ftpfilename})
mapper.select: SELECT /*+ LEADING(S1 SL1 DC) USE_NL(SL1) USE_NL(DC) */ S1.seq, S1.title, S1.text, S1.userid, S1.regdate, S1.hit, S1.good, S1.filename, SL1.goodlog, SL1.hatelog, NVL(DC.downcnt, 0) AS downcnt FROM SF01 S1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT seq, goodlog, hatelog FROM SFG1 WHERE seq = #{seq} AND sessionid = #{sessionid} ) SL1 ON S1.seq = SL1.seq LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(SFD1 PK_SFD1) */ seq, COUNT(*) AS downcnt FROM SFD1 WHERE seq = #{seq} GROUP BY seq ) DC ON S1.seq = DC.seq WHERE S1.seq = #{seq}
select S1.seq as seq, S1.userid as userid from SF01 S1 where S1.seq = #{seq}
SELECT /*+ INDEX_FFS(SF01 PK_SF01) */ COUNT(*) AS totCnt FROM SF01

SELECT /*+ LEADING(S1 R) USE_NL(R) */ S1.seq, S1.title, S1.text, S1.userid, S1.regdate, S1.hit, S1.good, NVL(R.reply, 0) AS reply FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(SF01 PK_SF01) */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seq DESC) AS rn, seq, title, text, userid, regdate, hit, good FROM SF01 ) WHERE rn > #{startRownum} AND rn <= #{endRownum} ) S1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT /*+ INDEX(SF02 IDX_SF02_1) */ seq01, COUNT(*) AS reply FROM SF02 WHERE parents = 0 GROUP BY seq01 ) R ON S1.seq = R.seq01

SELECT /*+ LEADING(T R) USE_NL(R) */ T.seq, T.title, T.text, T.userid, T.regdate, T.hit, T.good, NVL(R.reply, 0) AS reply FROM ( SELECT /*+ INDEX_DESC(SF01 idx_SF01_2) */ seq, title, text, userid, regdate, hit, good FROM SF01 WHERE 1 = 1
AND userid LIKE #{userid} || '%'
AND title LIKE #{title} || '%'
ORDER BY regdate DESC ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT seq01, COUNT(*) AS reply FROM SF02 WHERE parents = 0 GROUP BY seq01 ) R ON T.seq = R.seq01
select seq as seq, userid as userid, filename as filename, ftpfilename as ftpfilename from SF01 where seq = #{seq}
mapper.update: merge into SFG1 S1 using dual on (S1.seq = #{seq} and S1.sessionid = #{sessionid}) when matched then update set S1.datelog = #{datelog}, S1.goodlog = 'Y' when not matched then insert (S1.seq, S1.sessionid, S1.datelog, S1.goodlog ) values(#{seq}, #{sessionid}, #{datelog} , 'Y')

merge into SFG1 S1 using dual on (S1.seq = #{seq} and S1.sessionid = #{sessionid}) when matched then update set S1.datelog = #{datelog}, S1.hatelog = 'Y' when not matched then insert (S1.seq, S1.sessionid, S1.datelog, S1.hatelog ) values(#{seq}, #{sessionid}, #{datelog} , 'Y')
